stance_rationale: Alpha layer cannot graduate: rank_IC, subperiod stability, Harvey t, monotonicity, turnover, RF-A2 additivity, and No Silent Override artifacts all fail or remain unverified. The package mainly defers the decisive claim to downstream Forge/Optimizer while the inherited alpha itself is weak and crisis-regime IC is negative.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: alpha_scores has 29622 rows and 92 sig_dates, so it is not a literal one-date alpha snapshot. However date gaps are irregular at 57-123 days, the package says monthly/bi-monthly inconsistently, and required weights.csv is absent, so end-to-end RF-A7 schedule clearance is not possible.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Macro code uses manual sign_dir=-1 for mom_vol and yield_slope rather than an auditable Z_Score_Aligned mapping.
Current artifacts do not expose Usable_Date <= sig_date proof; C14 is asserted through inheritance only.
run_alpha_iter21.R directly read_parquet()s inherited alpha_scores and .cache parquet inputs; no load_month_factors() route is evidenced.
MSI construction uses Date < sig_dt and regime quantiles from strictly past msi_norm history; downstream optimizer shift remains unverified.
No new quarterly fundamental signal is introduced by MSI; inherited fundamental lag was not independently re-audited.

critical_concerns.description: Graduation gates fail materially: rank_IC=0.027 < 0.04, sub_stability=0.2041 < 0.50, Harvey 5-spec pass=0/5 with pooled t=-0.0238, and monotonicity=0.4444 < 0.80.
RF-A2 fails on the actual alpha_scores panel: score_str1701 ICIR=0.2009 is below z_C single-sleeve ICIR=0.2383, so the inherited composite is not adding value versus the best reported component.

AX-001 v2 defense claim is internally fragile: CRISIS IC=-0.0792 and bad_normal_ic_ratio=-4.163 contradict the claim that this layer conditionally strengthens crisis behavior; crisis_alpha=0.0244 is based on only 8 msi_norm > 0.75 dates.

PIT audit is overclaimed: manual sign direction is used for macro z-scores and direct parquet/cache reads bypass the stated load_month_factors discipline; C13/C15 cannot be marked PASS from these artifacts.
Turnover_proxy=6.9849 appears to imply 698.49% annual turnover, exceeding the hard <600% mandate; no current weights.csv exists to prove the downstream TO budget actually fixes it.

Charter §8 No Silent Override is not satisfied: challenge_note.md, factor_engine_proposal.R, risk_package.json, optimization_package.json, weights.csv, and covariance.parquet are absent for this WT, and the requested WT_WT-D20260427_005 / root stage_artifacts paths are missing.

supporting_arguments: RF-A3 did not trigger in my recompute: recent 3Y ICIR=0.1118 versus full ICIR=0.2009, ratio=0.56.
RF-A4 did not trigger in my sector-neutral recompute: sector-neutral ICIR improved rather than dropping 50%.
RF-A5 did not trigger in my top-decile liquidity check: top-decile 20d TV minimum was about 201.6m KRW with 0 rows below 100m or 200m.
alpha_scores.parquet has no duplicate Date-Ticker pairs, no future dates beyond 2026-04-27, and variable ticker counts from 179 to 351.
unresolved_disputes: weights.csv is missing, so schedule, max_names, sum(weights)=1, long-only, max_w, and turnover cannot be verified.
covariance.parquet is missing, so PSD and post-shrink condition number <= 100 cannot be verified.
DSR=0.9716 is unexplained relative to Harvey t near zero and should not be accepted without calculation lineage.
C14 is asserted through inheritance but the current artifact does not expose Usable_Date evidence.
The reproduction command points to run_all.R, but that file is absent.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that an inherited alpha failing most standalone gates and showing negative crisis IC can be rescued by a downstream macro cash overlay without a current harness-level PG2 backtest.
rebuttal_required: Provide Forge PG2 backtest proving SR > 1.4625, MDD < 45%, 15bps cost inclusion, and turnover < 600% under the MSI-driven policy.
Provide a complete challenge_note.md covering RF-A1 through RF-A7, especially RF-A2 comparator ICIRs and RF-A7 weights schedule.
Provide weights.csv and covariance.parquet for this WT, including multi-date schedule, PSD check, and condition number <= 100 post-shrink.
Explain or replace the C13 manual sign_dir macro alignment and C15 direct parquet reads with auditable approved loaders/mappings.
Provide DSR calculation provenance and reconcile DSR=0.9716 with Harvey 5-spec 0/5 pass.
rationalization_red_flags: Pure Function — schedule re-derivation = mandate violation

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: I do not accept the package's PASS/PENDING framing because the mandatory third-party artifacts and current harness validations are missing, while the inherited alpha diagnostics are already below gate.
